title: Notice-to-Vacate Discount on Repair Labor: Security Deposit Account
content:
**Term.** Notice given earns a notice discount on the labor of a Security Deposit Account damage repair charge. The discount depends on when the resident's written notice to vacate, on the lease's completed last term under the Lease Term Agreement, was received:

- **0.10 (10 percent)** when it was received at least 60 calendar days before the move-out date;
- **0.05 (5 percent)** when it was received at least 30, but fewer than 60, calendar days before it;
- **none** when it was received later, or when no notice is on file.

The discount reduces the labor only, that is, the hours of the repair times the labor rate. The parts are not discounted. The corrected repair charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** From the Lease Term Agreement: the date the written notice to vacate was received, on the lease's completed last term. From the deposit account: the move-out date.

## Ladder with boundaries (hypothetical, move-out 30 April)

| Notice received | Calendar days before move-out | Labor discount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 60 | 0.10 |
| 2 March | 59 | 0.05 |
| 31 March | 30 | 0.05 |
| 1 April | 29 | none |
| none on file | not applicable | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Labor of 3 hours at 65.00 USD is 195.00 USD. With a 0.10 discount, the labor is 175.50 USD. Parts of 40.00 USD are added in full, which gives 215.50 USD.
